title: Kalshi partners with smaller rival Novig to ask 35 states for access to "self-exclusion lists", which identify gambling addicts, to restrict problem gamblers (Bobby Allyn/Bloomberg)
summary: Bobby Allyn / Bloomberg: Kalshi partners with smaller rival Novig to ask 35 states for access to “self-exclusion lists”, which identify gambling addicts, to restrict problem gamblers — Even as Kalshi Inc. is fighting dozens of states in court, the prediction market platform is asking the states to help …
